<div class="card-body">
'''Alderaan''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オルデラン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">相手がここで戦闘運命数を求めるたびに、相手の戦闘運命数を－１できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配していれば、フォース消耗が＋１される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-121o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Alderaan.

'''Light Side:''' Each time the opponent draws battle destiny here, you may subtract 1 from their battle destiny.

'''Dark Side:''' If you control here, Force drain is increased by 1 here.

The Japanese Light Side text uses できる (may), while the original English card says to subtract 1.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Light may subtract 1 from opponent's battle destiny; English subtracts 1.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Alderaan]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
